messages:
Sam: thinking out loud — proposing a small UX affordance: add a per-change context menu on the policy/routing table rows in Console that can do 'Export selection ➜ audit slice' so compliance can grab the exact fields + before/after + actor + justification.
Anya: love the idea. question: do we include the full policy blob or just changed fields? clients usually want the minimal diff to stitch into their SIEM.
Kevin: minimal diff + pointer to the policy version id. otherwise downloads are huge and noisy. we already store full snapshots by versionId so export can include both if requested.
Maria: also need RBAC filtering — the menu should only show options the user can actually export (PII redaction modes). @audit-bot: can we attach redaction hints in the export payload so downstream consumers know what was removed?
audit-bot: yes — exports include "redaction_policy": "masked|tokenized|raw" and a per-field hint. we can embed schema hints.
Jordan: telemetry ask — add event for `export_initiated` with attrs: actor_id, export_scope (row|selection|time-range), redaction_mode, filter_hash. we want counts for who keeps exporting full blobs vs diffs.
Sam: UX flow question — context menu -> modal with checkboxes: include: [ ] changed_fields_only, [ ] include_full_snapshot, [ ] include_justification, [ ] sign_and_timestamp (for legal). default: changed_fields_only + include_justification.
Anya: modal should show a tiny preview: diff lines with inline anchors (like +/−) and a link to open the full change timeline when you hover. No more than 5 lines in preview.
Kevin: API shape: POST /internal/exports/audit with body:
```
{
  "version_id": "v123",
  "scope": "row",
  "fields": ["route","target","quota"],
  "diff_only": true,
  "redaction": "mask",
  "signed": false
}
```
Response 202 with job id and ndjson download URL when ready.
Maria: encryption/kms — signed exports must be stored S3 encrypted + contain a detached signature. enterprise-only toggle.
Sam: retention + quotas: each tenant has export_quota_per_month, and we should surface remaining quota in the modal and via API headers `X-Export-Remaining`.
Jordan: to avoid audit sprawl, require rate limiting for full_snapshot exports and sample them in telemetry.
Anya: design note — include small inline explanation next to 'signed' about legal evidentiary weight and that signed exports cannot be redacted later.
Kevin: implementation detail — backend will assemble export job by streaming NDJSON; each line = audit_event with shape we already use. e.g.
```
{"ts":"2026-01-12T14:22:01Z","actor":"kevin","field":"route","before":"/old","after":"/new","justification":"fix bug 412"}
```
Sam: important: we must preserve actor resolution (email vs display-name) according to tenant PII settings. add param `actor_resolution: raw|hashed|lookup_key`.
Maria: compliance requires audit traceability for rollouts — if a routing change was part of a canary rollout, export must include rollout_id and the evaluated conditions.
Jordan: telemetry event props spelled out in PR so analytics can roll up top exporters and average export sizes.
Anya: small accessibility note — context menu must be keyboard navigable and modal should default to the least-privileged export option.
Sam: can someone sketch the API acceptance criteria? I can take the UI and modal copy.
Kevin: I'll draft the API contract and the NDJSON schema. will include tests for actor_resolution permutations and redaction modes.
Maria: I'll own the KMS/signing bits and enterprise flag gating.
Jordan: I'll add telemetry events + quotas enforcement. also add a dashboard tile for monthly export usage per org.
Anya: I'll draft the modal and preview UX and push a quick Figma.
Sam: awesome — next steps: Kevin open endpoint PR, Maria add signing toggle + tests, Anya Figma by EOD Friday, Jordan telemetry + dashboard by next Wednesday. tagging @security and @compliance for visibility :eyes:
audit-bot: noted. created task AUT-721 "console: export audit slice modal + API" and linked to this thread.
Sam: thanks all. low-scope MVP: context menu -> diff-only NDJSON export with quota check + telemetry. we can iterate on signed exports later. :thumbsup:
